LESSON: WRITING 10.4.1 PUNCTUATION (THE EXCLAMATION MARK)

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.4: Writing 10.4.1 Punctuation (The exclamation mark)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 10.4.1 Punctuation (The exclamation mark), part of Strand 10 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to use the exclamation mark when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 10.4.1 Punctuation (The exclamation mark) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Communication and collaboration: Teamwork as the learner plays games with peers that involve placing the exclamation mark correctly in a text.

Values:
Respect: as the learners take turns to place exclamation mark correctly in a text as they play the game.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skill: Self-esteem as the learner uses exclamation mark correctly in writing.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The exclamation mark is learnt in Environmental Activities and Religious Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Adapted course book, Chart, class readers, course books, flash cards, recording devices e.g tablets, mobile phone, laptop, dictionary, internet, signed
